capabilities: : Reads time-boxed tasks from daily notes
: Provides personalized advice via AI chat
disambiguation: Not a scheduling tool; it analyzes existing daily notes to provide statistical insights.
extras: The AI assistant only sees summary numbers, not your full notes. An API-key provider needs internet access. Ollama runs on your machine and does not call a remote model host.
intentEvidence: Works alongside the Day Planner plugin — it does not replace your timeline; it adds a stats view on top of the notes you already write.
problem: Users struggle to gain long-term insights into their time usage and habit adherence from manually maintained daily notes.
